## Knight's move This move applies pressure. This is the traditional continuation from a 4-5 play. White's corner stone now feels lonely and if White plays there, Black will build outside influence naturally. **Tenuki** is the most common choice and allows White to avoid complications.
offers Black influence in exchange for corner territory but can be tricky if Black resists.
is complicated and works best if [the ladder](30948) is unfavorable for Black.
